sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by anti-CD9 mAb capture and colocalization in single-EV imaging; no functional assay of CD9 activity reported. NOT MEASURED for CD9 function per se.
sites.rationale: L1/L2 report mCherry inserted into the SEL of full-length, membrane-anchored CD9 with confirmed extracellular surface display on EVs. The SEL spans residues 38–58 (authoritative landmarks); no specific junction residue is named in the ledger, so insert_after_residue is null and the site is region-level. The insert is a large FP (~236 aa), demonstrating the loop tolerates substantial insertions; a short epitope tag (~15–23 aa) is expected to be at least as well tolerated. Cited_tag_residue is null because no residue number is given in the source. Full-length CD9 with mCherry inserted into the small extracellular loop (SEL, residues 38–58) expressed in Expi293F cells; EVs produced from this construct display mCherry on the extracellular surface of the EV membrane, confirmed by anti-CD9 antibody capture and single-EV imaging.

sources.claim: Fluorescent EVs were produced by transiently transfecting Expi293F cells with plasmids encoding either mEmerald-tagged CD9 (mEm-CD9) or mCherry inserted into the small extracellular loop of CD9 (CD9-SEL-mCh) (Fig. 2a ).

sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)

literature_notes: L3/L4 describe a C-terminal RFP fusion (CD9-RFP) that does not impair CD9 function. However, the CD9 C-terminus (residue 228) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks (IC3: 218–228, following TM4: 195–217). This is therefore not a surface tag site and is recorded in other_positions. L1 also describes mEm-CD9 (mEmerald fused to CD9) explicitly stated to label the cytosolic side of the membrane; this is likewise intracellular and recorded in other_positions. No ledger line names a specific junction residue within the SEL, so the SEL site is region-level only (insert_after_residue null). The large extracellular loop (LEL, residues 112–194) is not supported by any ledger line for an insertion and is therefore not proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal RFP tag (CD9-RFP) expressed in HEK293 cells and reported not to impair CD9 function, but residue 228 lies in IC3 (218–228), the intracellular C-terminal tail following TM4 (195–217); this is a cytoplasmic tag, not a surface tag.

mEm-CD9 (mEmerald fused to CD9) is explicitly described as labeling the cytosolic region of the EV membrane; the CD9 N-terminus (residues 1–9, IC1) is intracellular, consistent with this being an intracellular N-terminal fusion.
